case study · 02 / 05

KhataBox

A retail platform that connects stock decisions, billing, and realtime updates.

Next.jsTypeScriptFastAPIPostgreSQLscikit-learnRedis

Live project ↗　GitHub ↗

outcomes

20+ modules30+ REST APIsRandom Forest demand forecast

problem

Retail workflows spread inventory, customer orders, and billing across disconnected tools. KhataBox brings those operations into one platform.

architecture

decisions · why · trade-offs

Separate REST operations from stock broadcasts.

Most operations need a durable request/response path while stock changes need to reach open clients.

Trade-off accepted: Realtime clients must reconcile after reconnect.

Use PostgreSQL for the retail records.

Orders and inventory require durable relational data.

Trade-off accepted: Schema changes need deliberate migrations.

Use a Random Forest for weekly demand forecasts.

Sales history can inform restocking decisions.

Trade-off accepted: Forecasts support staff decisions rather than replace them.

result

  • Connected QR/barcode scanning, low-stock alerts, and PDF invoicing.
  • Added role-based JWT authentication, Redis caching, and responsive dashboards.

if I kept going…

  • Measure forecast quality against realised demand.
  • Add an explicit reconciliation view for reconnecting realtime clients.
